context: Recording mixed reproduction results honestly, with the tolerance rules, the validator and environmental caveats.

checklist.name: Slug and files located
checklist.description: The agent confirms the slug and locates the reference and analysis files before starting.

checklist.name: Existing repro checked
checklist.description: The agent checks benchmarks/sources/ for fastgrep-repro.md before running the harness.

checklist.name: Actual output quoted
checklist.description: The repro file quotes real harness output for each benchmark rather than restating the README.

checklist.name: Within-tolerance metrics verified
checklist.description: The three results within 10 per cent of the reported value are categorised as Verified.

checklist.name: Material differences recorded with both values
checklist.description: The two roughly 3x results are categorised as Not reproduced, quoting both the observed and the reported 10x figure.

checklist.name: Unavailable benchmark marked could not test
checklist.description: The GPU benchmark is categorised as Could not test with the reason stated.

checklist.name: Outcome is partially-verified
checklist.description: The frontmatter outcome is partially-verified, not verified and not failed.

checklist.name: Reported figures marked
checklist.description: Every README figure carries the (as reported) marker and is kept apart from observed figures.

checklist.name: Cold start documented
checklist.description: The cold-start penalty and the pinned commit a1b2c3d are recorded as environmental caveats.

checklist.name: No promotional framing
checklist.description: The summary states what held up and what did not and does not endorse the 10x claim.

checklist.name: Validator run and findings reported
checklist.description: The agent runs ./scripts/validate-repro-benchmark.sh on the new file and reports verified, unverified and caveats.
